title: Environmental Protection and Sustainability
description: Control environmental aspects, waste, spills and resource impacts.

lessons.title: Environmental Aspects and Impacts
lessons.summary: Apply environmental aspects and impacts through competent planning, verified controls, clear communication and reassessment whenever conditions change.

sections.heading: Purpose and Application
points: Environmental Aspects and Impacts is a core part of control environmental aspects, waste, spills and resource impacts.
The process must match the actual task, people, equipment, location, environment and applicable organizational requirements.
Only trained, competent and authorized people should perform duties that require formal competence or authorization.

sections.heading: Practical Control Process
points: Define the scope, identify credible hazards and people who may be affected, then verify controls before exposure begins.
Give priority to elimination, substitution and engineered protection before relying on procedures, training or PPE.
Communicate roles and stop-work conditions clearly, supervise the work and keep required evidence or records.

sections.heading: Field Scenario
points: During a field check, the team finds that conditions affecting environmental aspects and impacts have changed. Work is paused, the change is assessed, controls are corrected and the team is re-briefed before authorization to restart.
Never continue only because a permit, checklist or earlier assessment exists; documents support control but do not replace physical verification.

sections.heading: Lesson Summary
points: Apply environmental aspects and impacts through competent planning, verified controls, clear communication and reassessment whenever conditions change.

questions.prompt: What is the best first approach to environmental aspects and impacts?
options: Define the task and assess actual hazards
questions.explanation: Planning must reflect the real work and conditions.

questions.prompt: What should happen when conditions or scope change significantly?
options: Wait until the job is finished
questions.explanation: Change may invalidate the existing controls.

questions.prompt: What confirms that a control is effective?
questions.explanation: Controls must be implemented and verified in practice.
